worldcombat.skill.slackoff.summary: The user flops down and slacks off: it restores about half of maximum health at once, the quickest wind-up of the family, at the cost of a following Loafing stretch that lowers its movement speed by 22% until it shakes it off.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.use.0: Restore a big chunk with the shortest wind-up
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.use.1: Slack off in a gap the foe cannot reach
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.use.2: Trade the next stretch of mobility for health now
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.description.0: Flops down and restores up to %1$s of maximum health at once; then enters a %2$s Loafing stretch, during which movement speed is reduced by 22%% and wears off on its own. It cannot be used at full health.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.description.2: Wind-up %1$s and getting-up recovery %2$s, shortened by Speed; the shortest wind-up of the family.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.stance.deep: Deep nap: +0.06 healing and a 1.4x Loafing stretch - a fuller restore, but a longer spell of heavy feet.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.stance.doze: Doze: standard healing with a shorter Loafing stretch - back on its feet in a few breaths, for topping up in passing.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.preference.de: On (deep nap): +0.06 healing, a 1.4x Loafing stretch and 1.1x cooldown, at the cost of a longer mobility gap. Off (doze): slightly less healing, with a shorter Loafing stretch and cooldown, back on its feet in a few breaths.
worldcombat.skill.slackoff.preference.ai: The companion flops down below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher flops at the first wound.
